source_data.fixed_test_partition: Use TDC-provided test.csv unchanged except removal of structure leakage or unparseable structures from model scoring; record every exclusion.
source_data.train_validation_partition: Use TDC-provided train_val.csv; create five internal scaffold train/validation splits with PyTDC 1.1.15 create_scaffold_split behavior, frac=[0.875,0.125,0.0].
source_data.scaffold_definition: RDKit Bemis-Murcko scaffold, includeChirality=False, matching PyTDC 1.1.15.
source_data.duplicate_handling: Retain repeated measurement rows within their source partition. Group identical Bemis-Murcko scaffolds within each internal split. Remove all test rows whose standardized stereochemical InChIKey or Murcko scaffold occurs in train_val; list exclusions and rationale.
source_data.invalid_structure_handling: Retain invalid source rows in benchmark archives and inventory, but exclude them from fingerprint modeling and report exact counts.

uncertainty_and_domain.regression_intervals: Per seed, construct a 90% split-conformal prediction interval using the finite-sample corrected quantile of absolute residuals from that seed's internal scaffold validation set. Report fixed-test empirical coverage, interval width, and a 95% Wilson interval for coverage.
uncertainty_and_domain.applicability_domain: For each seed, calculate each validation/test/candidate molecule's maximum ECFP4 Tanimoto similarity to that seed's training compounds. Define that seed's domain cutoff as the 5th percentile of validation maximum-similarity values. A candidate is in-domain only if it meets or exceeds the cutoff in all five seeds. Report the cutoff and all five similarities.
uncertainty_and_domain.parent_checks: For each parent, report exact measured-label matches in raw and split benchmark data, training/validation/test membership, and maximum similarity to training compounds. Never describe a parent prediction as independently recovered when the parent was part of that seed's training set.

qualification_gate.regression: An endpoint predictor qualifies for reference-domain prediction only if its five-seed mean fixed-test MAE beats the training-median baseline, the 90% conformal test-coverage interval includes 90% in at least four of five seeds, the test partition has no unresolved exact-identity or scaffold leakage after the listed exclusions, and the endpoint scale is resolved. Compare the RF and nearest-neighbor errors; report which predictor is retained.
qualification_gate.scope: Qualification applies only to the tested TDC chemical domain and prediction endpoint. It does not qualify a candidate outside the measured applicability domain or imply pharmacological equivalence.

candidate_parent_comparison.candidate_cohort: 194 strict stereochemistry-passing states; no new structures added before the full-cohort screen.
candidate_parent_comparison.parent_reference: Use an exact, source-matched parent measurement from the same endpoint when available. If absent, ambiguous, or assay conditions cannot support a comparable reference, mark candidate-parent comparison unavailable.
candidate_parent_comparison.continuous_endpoint_delta: candidate predicted label minus exact measured parent label, in the original endpoint scale.
candidate_parent_comparison.model_resolution_tolerance: If and only if the predictor and candidate qualify, define endpoint-specific tolerance as the retained predictor's mean fixed-test MAE. This is a model-resolution criterion, not a biological or clinical equivalence margin.
candidate_parent_comparison.pass_rule: Pass only if the full 90% candidate prediction interval lies inside [parent measured value - held-out MAE, parent measured value + held-out MAE], the parent reference is source-comparable, and the candidate passes the all-five-seed applicability-domain rule.
candidate_parent_comparison.selection_rule: If multiple structures pass for one drug-endpoint, select the smallest absolute candidate-minus-parent difference; report denominator and all failures/abstentions. Treat the screen-selected exemplar as exploratory, not independent confirmation.
candidate_parent_comparison.no_qualified_predictor: Abstain for every candidate on that endpoint.

endpoint_decisions.definition: TDC/AstraZeneca experimental lipophilicity task; not generic calculated logP
known_limitations: assay-level pH and method metadata are not present in benchmark split files
